script.title: Hōrin-ji — Hall of the Nine Rings
script.description: An open-veranda Buddhist hall and three-storey pagoda, with layered black roofs, timber bracket sets, a golden altar and nine-ring sorin. Separate stone terraces and paired lanterns frame the approach.
